subject: Vendor onboarding: COI, W-9, and PO steps for Strata Systems

Subject: Vendor onboarding: COI, W-9, and PO steps for Strata Systems

Hi Tess —

Welcome — excited to start the onboarding process with Strata Systems. Procurement at Redwood needs a few items to complete vendor setup and issue a PO: 

1) Certificate of Insurance (COI) — preferred delivery as a PDF. Required lines:
   - Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Professional Liability / E&O: $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Cyber Liability: $1,000,000 (or evidence of claims-made coverage with retro date)
   - Certificate holder should be: Redwood Inference, Inc., 455 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105

2) Completed W-9 (or equivalent tax form for non-US entities)
3) Fully completed vendor setup form (link below) — includes remit address and vendor legal name
4) Point of contact for carrier verification (insurer name, broker contact, policy number, expiration)

Timeline: if possible, can you send the COI + W-9 back by EOD Monday 23 Mar? Our target PO issuance date is end of next week once docs validate.

Checklist link (please complete): https://procurement.redwood.ai/vendor-form/STR-0042

If Strata prefers to send initial drafts now (we can accept marked PDFs), that works — we just need the carrier/broker contact for verification.

Thanks — I’ll loop Laura to create the PO once we have remit details.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Commercial Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Hi Tess —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the draft attachments. A few clarifications so our procurement/legal teams can validate: 

- Certificate holder field should exactly read: "Redwood Inference, Inc., 455 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94105" — please include the full address on the COI.
- For E&O: if you can get an endorsement or a broker note confirming umbrella stacking to reach $2M that will be fine; otherwise a written confirmation from the insurer is acceptable for the PO issuance step, with the final endorsement to follow prior to contract start.
- Cyber: the intent notice is fine for now — we need the final policy PDF (or renewed COI) before the first invoice.
- Please include the policy numbers and effective/expiration dates on the COI PDF so we can log them in our vendor record.

I’ll ask Laura to open a PO as soon as we have the W-9 and a remit address (thanks for providing those). Once PO is issued, we’ll share the PO number and payment terms.

Next steps for you: send updated COI with certificate holder + policy numbers and the W-9 (we received your draft, thanks) — aim for Monday if possible. Laura, can you confirm PO creation timeline after receipt?

Thanks —
Jonas

Thanks for sending through the draft docs and remit details. I’ve added Strata to the PO queue. A few items to confirm so we can assign a PO number: 

- Confirm EIN (I have 94-1234567 from your email) — please confirm format (no dashes ok but we prefer exact on W-9).
- Confirm billing/remit email for electronic payments and whether ACH is supported (please provide bank remit instructions if ACH).
